name: proxydesk-seo
description: ProxyDesk SEO with simultaneous keyword groups and a shared browser fleet
author: ProxyDesk

scripts.browsers:install: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright install chromium firefox webkit
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run smoke && npm run runtime-smoke && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:desktop
